title: Fix Gadget Visibility and Button Width
instructions: Fix two issues: 1) Only hello_world gadget is visible in panel despite multiple gadgets being available, and 2) Gadget buttons are too narrow (2px width) making them hard to click. Review run.py to find where gadget buttons are created and fix the width.

1784834225.1650214.instruction: Check gadgets.json configuration and verify which gadgets are actually enabled. Then debug why only hello_world appears in the panel despite notices and test_gadget being available.

1784834229.2611308.instruction: Find the display_gadgets method in run.py and increase the button width from current setting to make buttons easier to click. Current width appears to be too narrow (around 2px).
